    private static int evaluate(int a, int b, int l, int r, char[] pat) {

    private static void run() throws IOException {

        int B = Integer.parseInt(input[1]);
        int L = Integer.parseInt(input[2]) - 1;
        int R = Integer.parseInt(input[3]) - 1;
        int best = R - L + 1;

        for (char a = 'a'; a <= 'z'; a++) {
            for (char b = 'a'; b <= 'z'; b++) {
                for (char c = 'a'; c <= 'z'; c++) {
                    char[] pattern = {a, b, c};
                    best = Math.min(best, computeDistinct(A, B, L, R, pattern));
                }
            }
        }

        out.println(best);
    }

    private static int computeDistinct(int aLen, int bLen, int start, int end, char[] pattern) {
        int cycle = aLen + bLen;
        char[] base = new char[3 * cycle];
        
        for (int block = 0; block < 3; block++) {
            int idx = block * cycle;
            fillAChars(base, idx, aLen);
            Arrays.fill(base, idx + aLen, idx + cycle, pattern[block]);
        }

        int offset = start % cycle;
        int count = end - start + 1;
        char[] window = new char[count];
        System.arraycopy(base, offset, window, 0, Math.min(count, base.length - offset));

        int[] freq = new int[26];
        for (char ch : window) {
            freq[ch - 'a'] = 1;
        }

        int distinct = 0;
        for (int f : freq) {
            distinct += f;
        }
        return distinct;
    }

    private static void fillAChars(char[] arr, int offset, int length) {
        boolean[] used = new boolean[26];
        for (int i = offset - 1; i >= offset - length && i >= 0; i--) {
            used[arr[i] - 'a'] = true;
        }
        char current = 'a';
        for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
            while (used[current - 'a']) current++;
            arr[offset + i] = current++;
        }
    }
}
